design: Tall highly athletic adult guard with pale grey-black tiger banding on skin, exposed angular mandibled skull, deep-set amber eyes, long black dreadlocks swept entirely over left shoulder. Narrow V-shaped dark breastplate with bronze raised spine, large stacked right shoulder armor, left arm in chainmesh bracer, long dark asymmetric coat panels to calves, clawed bare feet. Long lightweight double-ended combistick is strapped vertically along back, right hand on wrist device and left relaxed near abdomen. Quiet observant stance.
